title: Human Misperception of Generative-AI Alignment: A Laboratory Experiment

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a Relative Prediction Accuracy (RPA) measure to compare whether human subjects' predictions of a Generative AI's choices in economic problems are closer to the actual average human choice than to the actual Generative AI choice.

Using linear regression to measure the correlation between individual human subjects' predictions of Generative AI choices and their own personal choices in the same or related economic decision environments.
